en.body:
EDGE held its first two outreach events in Bern on the evenings of both 21 and 23 August 2023. These events are called "Energy Drinks": you come and have a drink at the bar while listening to four presentations per night on hot energy topics in Switzerland, followed by games, quiz and prices to win!

Full programme accessible [here](/news/energy-drinks-event-in-bern-3/)
